content.short: Sherpa is a delta-neutral USDC vault issuing shUSD shares routed through quantitative strategies.
content.description: Sherpa takes USDC deposits into delta-neutral strategies and issues shUSD representing a share of the vault, so holders are exposed to the strategy's return and not to market direction. The vault is quant-driven and managed by Hedgemony, running on defined cycles with utilisation and TVL published live. Deposits are hands-free once made, with performance viewable over windows from one week to a year.
